Andrew and Tristan Tate arrested in Miami; UK seeks extradition

Social media personalities Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami by federal authorities on Saturday. While the US Marshals Service confirmed their custody, specific charges remain sealed. The brothers are reportedly wanted in the United Kingdom for serious allegations including rape, sex trafficking, and child exploitation offenses, with the UK expected to seek their extradition.
